criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.finding: EVERY real compile call Mission 4 (and Missions 2-3) made ran with an EMPTY Phase 2D context bundle.
criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.evidence: All four validation scripts (scripts/final-phase3-closure-holdout-run.ts, post-holdout-semantic-remediation-rerun.ts, final-semantic-decomposition-holdout-replay.ts, final-semantic-decomposition-reality-check.ts) construct an ad-hoc DiscoveredCandidate with `structuralNodeIds: []` (only the deprecated label-shaped structuralNodeKeys is set). context-retrieval/pipeline.ts anchors exclusively on candidate.structuralNodeIds[0] (Phase 3F.1.2 occurrence-safe identity) and, finding none, returns sufficiencyState INCOMPLETE with zero items and the HIGH-severity unresolved dependency 'Cannot retrieve context for a candidate with no anchoring structural node.' Re-derived deterministically in 06-shared-cap-root-cause-trace.json: itemCount 0 for both DSGR regions as run; 47-48 items (child rules, definitions, definition dependencies) when the real nodeId is supplied.
criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.consequence: Mission 4's A1-A6/B1-B4 and 12-region numbers measured the compiler WITHOUT any of the definitions/child clauses/cross-references Phase 2D exists to provide; every 'VERIFICATION_INCOMPLETE' verdict in those runs traces to verify.ts's `contextBundle.sufficiencyState !== SUFFICIENT` rule, not to a semantic finding. This is a validation-harness defect (the real discovery pipeline always populates structuralNodeIds), and it is exactly the class of defect Section 12's source-context sufficiency check exists to make impossible to miss.
criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.howThisMissionHandlesIt: The frozen-holdout and whole-agreement validations keep source, GT, regions, provider/model, verifier and scoring byte-identical; the harness now supplies the real physical nodeId (as production does) and the new source-context sufficiency layer records, per unit, exactly what context state the compile ran under. The pre-fix Mission 4 numbers are retained unmodified as the comparison baseline.

criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.finding: Mission 4's 'zero SharedCapacity objects produced' claim was partly a MEASUREMENT artifact.
criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.evidence: The Mission 4 scripts preserved compile output as {status, rules, definitions, failureReasons, telemetry} - never sharedCapacities, toolCallLog, or rawModelOutput. In the preserved investments-dsgr output, rule ir-rule:b4ebe266 (§6.04(b)) carries capacityExpression LEDGER_USAGE_REFERENCE with sharedCapId ir-sharedcap:949e9cac..., which can only exist if the model DID emit a WireSharedCapacity that normalize.ts resolved. The object itself was dropped from the preserved file.
criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.consequence: The composition layer CAN produce a SharedCapacity for a same-batch shared cap; what was lost is (a) preservation, (b) the cross-unit linkage (see 06).

criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.finding: Cross-unit dependencies the model DID emit were silently dropped at normalization.
criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.evidence: Preserved sufficiencyReasons on §6.04(b)/(c)/(d)/(f): 'dependsOn[0].targetRef "Section 6.01(b)(iii)" did not resolve - dependency dropped rather than left dangling' (and Section 6.01(c)(iii), Section 6.01, Section 6.07). normalize.ts's resolveRuleRef accepts only a same-batch localRef or a literal ir-rule: id; IRRuleDependency has no representation for a real but externally-targeted dependency.
criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.consequence: A DEPENDENCY_ARCHITECTURE gap: the IR can only express dependencies within one compilation unit.

criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.finding: Cross-reference resolution fails for two generic drafting shapes.
criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.evidence: Structural index: 'Section 6.04(b)' NOT_FOUND (a leading 'Section ' prefix is not normalized on the query side; '6.04(b)' alone is UNIQUE) and '6.01(b)(iii)' NOT_FOUND (an inline roman-numeral proviso inside a lettered clause is not its own node). Bare '6.04'/'6.01' are AMBIGUOUS because the document's table of contents is parsed as a second, degenerate SECTION occurrence (ownLen 33-78 chars, 0 children) sharing the label with the body section (descLen 7,851-8,790 chars, 17-18 children).
criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.consequence: Both the model's own getReferencedProvision calls ('cross-reference resolution attempted for both and failed, then tool budget was exhausted') and Phase 2D's reference expansion lose the sibling provision. Generic - no DSGR-specific text is involved.

criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.finding: Even with a real anchor, Phase 2D's text budget is consumed by definition-dependency chains before explicit cross-references are expanded.
criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.evidence: With the real nodeId, both regions stop with 'maxTextBudgetChars reached' and 'maxDefinitionDepth (5) reached' carrying 25-27 DEFINITION_DEPENDENCY items and ZERO CROSS_REFERENCE items, even though detectStructuralReferences resolves 'Section 6.04(b)' from §6.01(b)(i)/(c)(i) uniquely (targetNodeId set).
criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.consequence: A CONTEXT_RETRIEVAL prioritization limit - the compilation unit Section 13 asks for (provision + required definitions + EXPLICIT cross-references) is not what the bundle delivers when definitions are deep.

criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.finding: The Mission 4 anchor selection used a closed interval and mis-anchored one region.
criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.evidence: findAnchorNode used charStart <= idx <= charEnd; the investments region (offset 455225) anchored to the PRECEDING clause 6.03(g) whose charEnd == 455225, not to §6.04 (whose charStart == 455225). Half-open [charStart, charEnd) anchors correctly.
criticalBaselineFindingsThatReframeMissi.consequence: Validation-harness defect only; corrected in this mission's scripts.
